facts.detail: BDUK publishes monthly contract-level data on Project Gigabit contract progress.
Contracted-premises figures include only the initial contract scope; deferred-scope premises may be absent.
The July publication is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 16 July 2026.
The contract table is rounded to the nearest 10 and totals may not sum because of rounding.
The table total reports 838,490 initial-scope contracted premises and 287,510 built contracted premises.

facts.detail: BDUK estimates 192,570 premises received gigabit-capable coverage in 2025/26, 42,280 or 28% more than the previous year.
Estimated cumulative BDUK-subsidised gigabit-capable coverage reached 1,418,410 premises by March 2026.
Gigabit Infrastructure Subsidy contracts accounted for 72% of 2025/26 delivery, or 139,490 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 90% of 2025/26 delivery, or 173,190 premises.
An estimated 43,880 delivered premises, 23%, did not previously have superfast availability of at least 30 Mbit/s.

facts.detail: BDUK quarterly and annual delivery-performance official statistics have been published since July 2025.
The official series includes BDUK-subsidised premises from 2012 onward and revised figures for earlier periods.
Quarterly releases cover nation or region, premises type, and intervention type.
Annual releases add Local Authority District, Parliamentary Constituency, and urban or rural breakdowns.
Future releases are planned to add one new quarter with cumulative totals and build a quarterly series back to April 2024.

facts.detail: BDUK reports delivery progress through annual reports and accounts and through official statistics.
BDUK began reporting delivery performance as official statistics in 2025.
Quarterly official statistics contain a subset of the full annual tables.
BDUK separately publishes monthly Project Gigabit contracted-and-built reports.
Contract-management reports and subsidy-attributed official statistics are not directly comparable.

facts.detail: The portal collects research from BDUK Evaluation and Analysis teams.
The portal groups material into evaluations, in-house research, evaluation plans, and commissioned research.
The stated purpose is to assess intervention efficacy, inform programme design, and understand emerging impacts.
The portal was last updated on 26 June 2026 when the BDUK GigaHubs Evaluation was added.
The portal lists evaluation plans for Project Gigabit, BDUK Hubs, Local Full Fibre Network, and Shared Rural Network.

facts.detail: The June 2025 Spending Review provided BDUK with £1.9 billion capital investment through 2029/30 for Project Gigabit and Shared Rural Network delivery.
The 99% UK gigabit-coverage target date was revised from 2030 to 2032.
UK gigabit coverage reached 85% in October 2024 and exceeded 87% by the end of March 2025.
BDUK reported 152,700 premises passed in the year to 31 March 2025 and 1,227,000 cumulative premises passed.
Project Gigabit delivery is described through four interventions: Gigabit contracts, Superfast contracts, vouchers, and GigaHubs.

facts.detail: The January 2026 OMR and BDUK plans publication was published on 4 June 2026.
The main publication applies to England and Wales, with linked publications for Scotland and Northern Ireland.
The publication includes a UPRN-level release user guide and technical note.
Regional ZIP releases are provided for English regions and Wales, including a London file.
The dataset is BDUK’s current premises-level view of OMR determinations, current connectivity, future commercial plans, and BDUK interventions.
